title: BYOB Party Boat for All Events, Bachelor(ettes), Birthdays.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children under 12 have to wear life vests on board.
Max up to 12 guests per booking at fixed price
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
For all Events and Parties: Work Party, Team building, Family reunions, Bachelor(ettes), Birthdays, Celebrations, 

Float, Vibe, Celebrate

Drop anchor at the legendary Party Cove—the heart of the lake party scene. Time to blast the tunes, float on the lily pad, and soak up the good vibes with your best crew.

Whatever you’re celebrating, this is your moment to cheers, chill, and let the good times roll. Champagne in hand, music up, sun out—it doesn’t get better than this

Surrounded by luscious greenery, luxurious Realestate and the warmth of Texas. Come relax, soak up the sun or from shaded cover and enjoy the scenic views of Lake Austin from a boat. 

Guaranteed to leave you with positive memories with your friends and family that will last a lifetime. 

Can customize your boat prior to trip with balloons or banners! Make it memorable
